bio.zh: 我是孙嘉渝（Jiayu Sun），电子科技大学软件工程专业本科生，关注具身智能与强化学习。目前主要探索视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型的多任务强化学习与策略融合，也曾参与基于 IsaacLab 和 Unitree G1 的仿真到真实机器人流程搭建。希望通过这个网站记录研究思考、技术实践、课程笔记与日常生活。
bio.en: I'm Jiayu Sun, an undergraduate studying Software Engineering at the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (UESTC). My interests lie in embodied AI and reinforcement learning. I currently explore multi-task reinforcement learning and policy merging for vision-language-action (VLA) models, and have worked on a sim-to-real robotics pipeline using IsaacLab and Unitree G1. Here, I share research reflections, technical projects, course notes, and moments from everyday life.
